name: pi-webrtc
description: Low-latency hardware-accelerated WebRTC video streaming and remote control for Raspberry Pi & NVIDIA Jetson

latest_release.name: v4.0.0
latest_release.body:
- fix: close the peer connection on DISCONNECT without releasing it inside its own callback (2622dd9)
- fix: build with libcamera that uses std::span (13689e3)
- feat: cf sfu worker (#385) (0168655)
- docs: add a low bitrate page with encoder curves and the jetson resolution steps (6d17a85)
- feat: floor the video bitrate at --min-bitrate, with a jetson default for a fixed resolution (3712cdd)
- feat: switch the jetson encoder's resolution by its encoded bitrate (dfb0aa5)
- fix: stop openh264 from treating sensor noise as scene changes (1226eb1)
- fix: let the jetson decoder wait for an idr frame instead of stopping after a second (8dd9837)
- feat: add ros 2 examples and a guide that stream an image topic and drive cmd_vel (9bbcc39)
- fix: make the virtual camera examples run on python 3 and current v4l2loopback (954f661)
- docs: add an rtsp camera guide for mediamtx, gstreamer and deepstream (6c9d2a2)
- docs: rewrite the docs for the topic folders, with a readme per folder (0036330)
- chore: fetch the protocol submodule over https (06a02ad)
- docs: move the docs into topic folders (64f3635)
- chore: remove latency demo GIF (e3993dc)
- docs: split camera and encoding into separate pages (458f023)
- chore: remove gperftools and profiler library (6a2a29b)
- chore: remove unused include path for json_schema_compiler (5ad9143)
- fix: let the jetson scaler read frames from cpu memory, such as a v4l2 loopback (2e2d63d)
- feat: give libcamera cameras a sub-stream (60cfa1e)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mazupo/pi-webrtc/compare/v3.1.0...v4.0.0
